revision: 9, parent: 8, author: "LOX-ψ", domain: "nethack", reason: "Starvation deaths at depth 1 are persisting despite previous radius increases, with episodes lasting ~8000 turns. The agent is stuck in explore_floor without transitioning to foraging or praying. Reducing the prayer routine interval significantly to trigger emergency food recovery more frequently and lowering the routine prayer first-threshold to ensure the agent seeks divine sustenance before the hunger state becomes critical."
set nutrition.pray_routine = 600
set nutrition.pray_routine_first = 200
set nutrition.food_radius_hungry = 120

args: SELECT episode_id, death_message, total_turns, final_hp FROM episodes WHERE death_category = 'melee' AND max_depth <= 2
SELECT episode_id, death_message, total_turns, final_hp, max_depth FROM episodes WHERE death_category = 'melee'
